none: PAS NLM-213600: Roman Coin fragment: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus fragment of Constantine I (306-337), Soli Invicto Comiti issue of 310-319, Reece period 15. Obverse description: Bullnecked bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--](--)NTINVSPFAVG. Reverse description: Sol standing left. Reverse inscription: [SOLI INVICTO COMITI]. Diameter: 19.5mm, Weight: 1.46gms, die axis: probably 6
